GraphQL Query Builder

Build a GraphQL query from an indented field tree — operation name, nesting and arguments supported.

📖 How to use

  1. Type fields one per line, indenting with 2 spaces per level.
  2. Add arguments inline, e.g. user(id: 1).
  3. Set the operation type and name.
  4. Copy the query or download it as .graphql.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I nest fields?

Indent child fields with 2 spaces per level — the builder turns indentation into nested braces.

How do I add arguments?

Write them inline: user(id: "1", active: true) — everything in parentheses is kept verbatim.

Can I add variables?

Yes — declare them in the signature field, e.g. ($id: ID!), and reference $id in your field arguments.

What operations are supported?

query, mutation and subscription, each with an optional operation name.
